content: VLA inference loop pattern: obs=env.reset(); for step in horizon: image=obs['agentview_image'][::-1]; action=vla.predict(image, language); obs,r,done,_=env.step(action). Key: images must be vertically flipped (OpenGL convention). Control freq is 20 Hz (OSC_POSE). VLA inference at 3-5 Hz with action hold or chunking to avoid blocking sim. Action shape (7,): 6D EEF delta + gripper float. robosuite OSC_POSE controller handles Jacobian IK internally.
